title: Macaw's Mystic's Biomes
description: A compatibility between Macaw's Mods and the different woods of Mystic's Biomes
body:
This mod adds compatibility between Macaw's Mods and Mystic's Biomes, have you always dreamed of making an strawberry roof... well thanks to this mod it is now something possible !

Sea Foam Bridge :
![Sea Foam Bridge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XQ6CZtXV/images/9fb51e10f326da1e57d611825283fdce53fe8484.png)
Strawberry Roof :
![Strawberry Roof](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XQ6CZtXV/images/d172504f00b0d886bdd5e762c75bdcab25aa75d2.png)
Maple Stuff :
![Maple Stuff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XQ6CZtXV/images/1cb5d503a98296b07b35de177c9a86d3188e600c.png)
Tropical Path and Hedge :
![Tropical Path and Hedge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XQ6CZtXV/images/28e28b76af6be3ad37def7f0d5369ba3e67cd2ef.png)

Required Depedency:

- [AddonsLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/addonslib)

- [Mystic's Biomes](https://modrinth.com/mod/mystics-biomes)

Optional Dependency:

- [Macaw's Mods](https://modrinth.com/user/sketchmacaw)
